title: Tingganghon Sude
chord: Ab · G · Am · F · C · G · F · Ab
lyrics:
Tingganghon sude na dokdok
Ale tu Jesus, Tuhanmu, na basa
Na susa roha, mandaodao tuam
Maporus tu Jesus na basa
Sonang ma roham, mardohar langkam
Hinorhon ni Jesus na basa

Arsak tongtong baenonNa bolong
Gogo do Tuhanmu na basa
